question.name: CSEC Phy Jun 2023 Q3 — Sound Wavelength, Speed in Water, Critical Angle
question.text:
(b)(ii) A note is produced by a musical instrument at a frequency of 11 000 Hz. The speed of sound in air is 330 m s⁻¹. Calculate the wavelength of this sound wave. (3 marks)

(c)(ii) Light travels from air into water. The refractive index of water is 1.3. Calculate the speed of light in water. (2 marks)

(c)(iii) Calculate the critical angle for the water-air boundary. (3 marks)
question.general_feedback:
Q3b(ii) — Wavelength of sound:

v = fλ → λ = v/f = 330 / 11 000 = 0.030 m = 3.0 cm

Q3c(ii) — Speed of light in water:

n = c_air / c_water → c_water = c_air / n = (3.0 × 10⁸) / 1.3 ≈ 2.31 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹

Q3c(iii) — Critical angle:

sin(c) = 1/n = 1/1.3 = 0.7692

c = arcsin(0.7692) ≈ 50.3°

steps.label:
Sound: f = 11 000 Hz | v_sound = 330 m/s
Light in water: n = 1.3 | c_air = 3.0×10⁸ m/s
Formulas: v = fλ | n = c_air/c_medium | sin(critical angle) = 1/n
Calculate the wavelength of the sound wave. (3 marks)
Calculate the speed of light in water. (2 marks)
Calculate the critical angle for the water-air boundary. (3 marks)

error_codes.SC_FORMULA_SELECTION_ERROR: Use the wave equation: v = fλ, rearranged as λ = v/f.

fields.label: Speed of light in water = _____ × 10⁸ m s⁻¹

error_codes.SC_FORMULA_SELECTION_ERROR: Rearrange n = c_air/c_medium to get c_medium = c_air/n.
At the critical angle: sin(c) = 1/n. Here, sin(c) = 1/1.3 = 0.7692.

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: c = arcsin(1/1.3) = arcsin(0.7692) ≈ 50.3°. Use the sin⁻¹ function on your calculator.
